basic_info.description: Welcome to 415 Ralston Street, a stylishly updated 2-level semi-detached midcentury home with Pacific Ocean views in San Francisco's desirable Merced Heights. Spanning 1,584 sq ft (per tax records), this 3BD/2BA residence is filled with natural light and features skylights, large double-pane windows, modern upgrades, and a seamless layout. The upper level offers two bright bedrooms, a renovated bathroom with shower and tub, and a cozy living area with fireplace that opens into a dining space and gourmet kitchen. The high-end, custom-made kitchen boasts quartz countertops, a black walnut breakfast bar, Euro-style Bellmont cabinets, stainless steel appliances, a Liebherr wine fridge, and a top-tier Miele Steam Convection Oven. Both the kitchen and upstairs bath showcase handcrafted Heath Ceramics tiles. Downstairs, a private primary suite opens to a redwood deck and a landscaped yard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Home-theater wiring in both living room & primary suite. Includes spacious 1-car garage with laundry, + 1-car driveway parking. Located near parks, SFSU, Stonestown, Ocean Ave, Whole Foods, H-Mart, MUNI, and BART. This dream home is ideal for both lifestyle and commute.
